name: Rainbow Dragon
description: Work-in-progress dual filament toolhead for Voron V0.2 using the Phaetus TaiChi dual filament hotend. Requires two NEMA 14 pancake stepper motors with BMG gear sets and one spare stepper driver slot. Built on the Dragon Burner v7+ platform with adapter mounts for larger Voron printers.
features: Dual filament capability via Phaetus TaiChi hotend
Two independent NEMA 14 pancake stepper motors
Dual BMG gear sets for independent filament control
No loss in X, Y, or Z workspace
Based on Dragon Burner v7+ platform
